headline: Türkiye Reports Record October Exports as Trade Deficit Narrows
summary: Türkiye's exports surged to a record $25.9 billion in October. Moderate import growth resulted in a narrowing trade deficit for the month.
why: Trade balance figures are a critical component of a country's macroeconomic health, influencing central bank policy, currency valuation, and sovereign debt ratings.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Record exports and a narrowing trade deficit strengthen the macroeconomic profile of the country.
